canonical_source.behavior: The canonical error page exposes a navigation-only Open logs anchor whose source destination is /logs.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: Because the public Error route has no tenant parameter, Laravel renders Open logs only when the authenticated identity has exactly one active tenant membership authorized for both Logs permissions. The target is generated from the existing guarded tenant Logs alias; zero or multiple eligible tenants fail closed.

runtime_path: ErrorReadController resolves exactly one eligible tenant from authenticated active memberships
platform.error preserves the existing Copy error details and Back to dashboard controls and conditionally renders AIMW-CONT-8B3518EF80

authorization.source_authentication: anonymous route; Open logs is absent for guests
authorization.source_tenant_context: not resolved by the Error route
authorization.tenant_selection: derived only from authenticated active memberships; exactly one Logs-authorized tenant is required
authorization.security_result: No caller-provided tenant or resource identifier is accepted by the control. Guest, unauthorized, ambiguous multi-tenant, and foreign-tenant paths fail closed.

semantics.persistence: read-only authorization over existing membership/role/permission state

coverage: exact live canonical PENDING identity before authorized integration
existing guarded tenant Logs alias and real Logs workspace are the only destination authority
one authorized tenant renders the exact operation marker and tenant-qualified href
guest and missing-permission identities do not receive the control
multiple Logs-authorized tenant memberships fail closed instead of choosing arbitrarily
multiple memberships with exactly one authorized tenant resolve only that tenant
foreign tenant requests return 404 and missing destination permission returns 403
composition-owned Copy error details AIMW-SYNC-89777052CB remains present and separate
composition-owned Back to dashboard AIMW-CONT-85394A0E55 remains present and separate

recovery.strategy: ancestry-preserving two-parent recovery onto the live composition tree; stale generated reconciliation edits are discarded and composition-owned Error controls are preserved

canonical_reconciliation.note: Canonical counts and state remain unchanged until authorized composition integration, exact-SHA evidence registration, generator regeneration, and post-integration validation.

terminality.basis: The recovered branch contains source-equivalent navigation and deterministic tenant/security proof, but canonical terminality is not claimed before authorized integration and generator reconciliation.
